auto.desc: Automatically route each prompt to the cheapest capable tier by scoring its difficulty (opt-in).
auto.hint: When on, a non-alias prompt is scored 0–1 and routed across your tier aliases ({tiers}). Applies once matching aliases exist above.
auto.title: Auto Routing

routingView.constraintsDesc: Advisory ceilings per provider: daily budget (USD), requests and tokens per minute. Over-limit providers are deprioritized, never hard-blocked.

difficulty.desc: Route easy prompts to a cheap model and hard ones to a capable model using a local heuristic (opt-in).

difficulty.title: Difficulty Routing

routingView.droppedEffortToast: Model {model} does not support a reasoning effort level, so that setting was ignored for this request.

routingView.noMatch: No alias matched — the model string would pass through unchanged.
routingView.noViableProvider: No viable provider for alias "{alias}" — every candidate is currently unavailable (breaker open, disabled, or filtered out).
routingView.overBudgetToast: Provider {provider} is over its daily budget (${spend} of ${budget}) but was the only available option. The request was sent anyway.

budget.desc: Minimize cost. Prefers free-tier and cheap models for casual conversations and simple tasks.
budget.name: Budget

performance.desc: Maximize quality. Uses flagship models for complex tasks, coding, and analysis.
performance.name: Performance

reliability.desc: Maximum uptime. Every alias gets 3+ providers with aggressive failover.

reliability.breakerEnabledDesc: Take failing deployments out of rotation automatically and probe them after a cooldown.
reliability.desc: Circuit-breaker behavior and the pre-call filter chain every routed request runs through.
reliability.filterChainDesc: Pre-call checks run in this order before the routing strategy picks a candidate. Plugins can contribute filters; reference them in the routing config to activate.
reliability.modeFailureRateDesc: Open when the failure ratio crosses a threshold at sufficient volume.
reliability.retryAfterNote: Retry-After hints from provider errors extend the cooldown automatically, clamped by the max cooldown.
reliability.title: Reliability

routingView.revertNote: Your current configuration is snapshotted — one click reverts the activation.

semantic.desc: When many plugin tools are exposed, keep only the ones most relevant to the current prompt (local embeddings, opt-in).
semantic.hint: Comma-separated tool names that always stay exposed. Built-in tools are never pruned.
semantic.title: Semantic Tool Routing

routingView.strategyDesc: How the engine picks among an alias's candidate providers.

strategyExplain.adaptive: Success-heavy score with a penalty for providers that errored recently.
strategyExplain.balanced: Weighted score: 40% success rate, 30% latency, 30% cost.
strategyExplain.cost: Cheapest candidate by catalog price (USD per 1M tokens) wins.
strategyExplain.difficulty: Scores the prompt and routes hard prompts to your strong model, easy ones to the weak model. Configure the model pair below.
strategyExplain.least-busy: Routes to the candidate with the fewest concurrent in-flight turns right now.
strategyExplain.quality: First entry in your priority order wins. Predictable and user-controlled.
strategyExplain.speed: Lowest recent P50 latency wins, based on live health metrics.

routingView.testDesc: See which provider the next send would pick for an alias, using live health, budget, and rate data.
